english.note: Use this when emphasizing the actual outcome or consequence, often at the start of the result clause.

examples.english: They forgot to bring an umbrella in the morning; consequently, they were soaked after work.
examples.traditional: 佢朝早唔記得帶遮，結果放工嗰陣濕晒。
